entities.name: Predator
entities.description: A 500-foot Rathi/Phyrexian skyship built to help control the Kor, Vec, Dal and Skyshroud elves, commanded by Greven il-Vec and finally destroyed crashing into the Stronghold.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: The brutal commander of the Predator, killed by Tahngarth.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship of Gerrard's crew, the Predator's nemesis.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Weatherlight's captain, whose kidnapping preceded the first encounter with the Predator.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member taken hostage by the Predator's crew.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member who killed Greven.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: The Predator's main prize, knocked overboard and later captured and teleported into the Stronghold by Ertai.

entities.name: Vhati il-Dal
entities.description: Predator's first mate who made a deliberate attack that almost killed Greven.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Left behind on Rath, he kept a planar portal open and later captured Gerrard for the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: A Rathi rebel who attempted to sabotage the Predator.

entities.name: Lin Sivvi
entities.description: A Rathi rebel who attempted to sabotage the Predator.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: The Phyrexian base where the Predator was docked and finally crashed.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The artificial plane whose natives the Predator terrorized.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The overlay of Rath with Dominaria.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: The forest into which Gerrard was knocked.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Where the Predator and Weatherlight fought for the last time.

events.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew takes Karn, Tahngarth and the Legacy artifacts hostage while Gerrard is knocked overboard.
events.quote: When Weatherlight planeshifted to Rath, it was ambushed by the Predator

events.summary: Predator and Weatherlight duel as Weatherlight races to the portal Ertai holds open; Weatherlight escapes and both ships are heavily damaged.
events.quote: Weatherlight just managed to get to the portal and escape her pursuer, with both vessels sustaining major damage.

events.summary: Rathi rebels including Eladamri and Lin Sivvi attempt to sabotage the docked Predator but are foiled.
Predator battles Weatherlight over Urborg; Ertai captures Gerrard and teleports him into the Stronghold.
events.quote: managed to capture Gerrard and teleport him directly into the Stronghold.

events.summary: Tahngarth kills Greven and Predator is destroyed by being sent crashing into the Stronghold.
events.quote: Greven himself was killed by Tahngarth.

relations.quote: It was placed under the brutal command of Greven il-Vec
Weatherlight first encountered its nemesis following the kidnapping of Captain Sisay .

relations.note: Killed Greven in the final battle.
relations.quote: Greven himself was killed by Tahngarth.

relations.note: First mate who nearly killed him in a deliberate attack.
relations.quote: their commander Greven was almost killed by a deliberate attack from first mate Vhati il-Dal

relations.note: Rebels tried to sabotage the vessel.
relations.quote: the target of a sabotage mission by Rathi rebels

relations.note: Stayed in dry dock at the Stronghold.
relations.quote: Predator mainly stayed in dry dock at the Stronghold for repairs
